_comment: CIVILIAN kit: a faired COMMS DISH - a low twelve-sided radome the shape of an airliner SATCOM blister, not a spike. The salvage whip leans overboard and the armoured mast rakes; a civilian antenna is a PRODUCT, so the dish is a smooth hull-coloured dome on a skirt with one cobalt pinline where the cowling meets the hull and one small amber tell-tale on top. Twelve sides for the same reason the fairing has them: the piece must read as ROUND against flat panelling.
